subject.title: fix: recover final replies after settled tool-only turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a shared, tool-disabled continuation after an otherwise settled tool-only terminal turn has no visible final reply?
rationale: This is an intentional change to the agent-runtime terminal contract and is protected for maintainer judgment; the earlier related proposal used a more restrictive replay-safe boundary.

options.title: Approve the bounded recovery
options.body: Accept the shared recovery after the branch is rebased and the current-head runner and Telegram proof confirm no extra tool execution or terminal-state regression.

options.title: Retain the stricter boundary
options.body: Limit continuation to a narrower replay-safe or read-only subset if maintainers do not want settled side-effecting calls to receive an additional model turn.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep the regression issue open while defining the canonical terminal fallback contract before merging this behavior change.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the shared recovery after the branch is rebased and the current-head runner and Telegram proof confirm no extra tool execution or terminal-state regression.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest available history signal is the author of the previous alternative implementation that framed the competing safety boundary.
